faq.a: Nnamdi is associated with the Igbo form نَّامْدِي, whose core sense is nnamdi; my father is alive (igbo).

faq.q: What is the origin of Nnamdi?
faq.a: Nnamdi is associated with Igbo. Nnamdi is Igbo, from ńnà ('father') + m dị ('is alive'), meaning 'my father is alive'. It is used as a male given name.
No — the underlying form is Igbo, not Arabic.
Nnamdi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Igbo-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nnamdi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nnamdi is an Igbo name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Nnamdi mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Nnamdi is rendered نامدی and carries the sense نامدی، میرا باپ زندہ ہے.

faq.q: What does Nnamdi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nnamdi is rendered نامدی and carries the sense نامدی، پدرم زنده است.
A romanized syllable approximation is nnam-di. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nnamdi?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nnamdi, nnamdi. Script forms are نامدي, نامدی, نَّامْدِي, न्नामदी.

faq.q: Is Nnamdi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
